gold_points: Domestic PVC demand fell 7% in 2022 from record 2021 levels
Export demand rose 46%; exports were 27% of North American production
Higher interest rates, lower housing starts and inflation weakened domestic demand
2023 domestic PVC demand expected neutral to lower; lower residential construction offset by infrastructure and global demand
